title: Day and Trial Passes: walk-in purchase and advance-purchase requirement
content:
This document covers the Day and Trial Passes product line: whether a tier may be purchased and used the same day without advance booking, whether advance purchase is required instead, and the minimum hours of advance purchase required where it is.

## Per-tier basis

| Tier | Walk-in allowed | Advance purchase required | Advance purchase window (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Single Day Pass | Yes | No | 0 |
| Three-Day Trial Pass | Yes | No | 0 |
| Seven-Day Trial Pass | Yes | No | 0 |
| Weekly Visitor Pass | No | Yes | 24 |
| Monthly Trial Pass | No | Yes | 24 |
| Corporate Guest Pass | No | Yes | 24 |

A tier flagged as walk-in allowed may be purchased and used the same day without advance booking, and defines an advance-purchase window of zero hours since none is required. A tier that instead requires advance purchase must be purchased at least the listed number of hours before use; the Weekly Visitor Pass, the Monthly Trial Pass and the Corporate Guest Pass each require at least 24 hours of advance purchase and are not available as same-day walk-in purchases.
